answer: Use bonded sponsorship: an established agent must stake a slashable bond behind each newcomer, and any three challengers can burn that stake if the newcomer is a duplicate. A Sybil farm then needs one independent, already-bonded sponsor per forged identity, so a thousand fakes need a thousand real sponsors, and cost scales with nets rather than one wallet. A randomness lagoon assigns each cluster to an auditor nobody controls, an inflation plume dilutes vote weight per account, and past the vertex of that yield curve the reward per fake falls below its bond.
